meta.description: Identify differentially accessible chromatin regions across conditions using DiffBind, csaw, DESeq2, or edgeR; covers consensus-peak vs sliding-window choice, normalization, SVA/RUVseq batch handling and effect-size thresholds.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; planted K562-only peaks recovered at 0.970-0.992

methodological_ground.detail: Default DESeq2 path is sound; silent CLI-arg and normalization inconsistencies are filed as P1 findings, not principled fallacies

code_usability.detail: Input 3: shipped use_sva=TRUE branch fails on a 4-sample design and never applies the SVs; Input 5: empty result crashes

functional_suitability.note: Runnable script covers only a DESeq2 two-group contrast; edgeR/csaw/RUVseq/spike-in/covariate design are recipes, not code

reliability.note: SVA branch crashes; zero-hit contrast crashes; documented CLI args silently ignored

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 57 lines with routed references; method-reference is 317 lines but routed

agent_usability.note: Clear trigger and workflow; script usage promises parameters the CLI does not expose; default normalization contradicts SKILL.md workflow

human_usability.note: Undocumented control/treated label requirement; misleading errors; heatmap colour bars have no legend

security.note: No injection or destructive surface; plain file inputs and outputs in cwd

maintainability.note: Dependencies and versions stated and satisfied; license and provenance preserved; stale usage line

agent_specific.note: Description is precise; body oversells SVA/edgeR/RUV as supported by the script

key_strengths: Default DESeq2/DiffBind CLI runs end to end on real ENCODE data and recovers planted K562-only peaks at 0.97-0.99
Diagnostics PDF contains four populated, interpretable figures (PCA, MA, volcano, heatmap)
Method reference gives a coherent decision table, normalization-trap analysis and cited literature
Stated package minimums are met by current Bioconductor releases; provenance and license preserved

recommendations.title: SVA branch crashes and never corrects
recommendations.problem: use_sva=TRUE fails with hard-coded n.sv=2 on 4 samples; even when it runs, SVs are only printed and never enter the model, yet the log implies a correction.
recommendations.root_cause: SVA snippet is an extraction example, not a tested analysis path, and use_sva is not reachable from the CLI.
recommendations.fix: Choose n.sv with num.sv capped by sample count, feed SVs into the design and assert the model uses them; else remove the branch and route to the tested method-reference recipe. DAC-001.

recommendations.title: Documented CLI args 2-5 silently ignored
recommendations.problem: Usage lists output_prefix, normalize_mode, fdr_thr, lfc_thr but only args[1] is used; requested FDR 0.01 / lfc 3 silently become 0.05 / 1.
recommendations.fix: Parse and validate args (or named flags) including use_sva; reject unknown values. DAC-002.

recommendations.title: Default normalization contradicts the Skill guidance
recommendations.problem: Script default DBA_NORM_NATIVE yields RLE with RiP library size; SKILL.md calls full-library the default and the usage guide prescribes DBA_NORM_LIB for cross-cell-type comparisons. Opened/closed split moves from 535/561 to 766/415.
recommendations.root_cause: The effective library method is never logged and the defaults were not reconciled.
recommendations.fix: Pick one default consistent with the guidance, log norm.method/lib.method from dba.normalize, and state the RiP trade-off in the Skill body. DAC-003.

recommendations.title: Annotation PDF omits TSS-distance plot
recommendations.problem: plotDistToTSS returns a ggplot that is never printed inside pdf(); the file has one page.
recommendations.root_cause: ggplot objects are not auto-printed inside a function.
recommendations.fix: print() the plot object and assert page count. DAC-004.

recommendations.title: Zero-hit contrast crashes
recommendations.problem: A legitimate empty result stops with export(NULL) and no outputs.
recommendations.fix: Guard empty results: write empty BEDs/CSV and a clear message. DAC-005.

recommendations.title: control/treated labels hard-coded and undocumented
recommendations.problem: Other Condition labels fail with a misleading error.
recommendations.root_cause: dba.contrast is fixed to c(Condition, treated, control).
recommendations.fix: Take group labels as parameters or document and validate them. DAC-006.

recommendations.title: edgeR/RUV/spike-in/covariate paths lack runnable code
recommendations.problem: Only DESeq2 two-group runs; edgeR (via DiffBind), csaw and RUV recipes executed by tooling as reference code only; spike-in and covariate design not executed.
recommendations.root_cause: Skill body lists them as workflow options without shipped code.
recommendations.fix: Ship a parameterised edgeR backend and design argument, or label the rest recipe-only. DAC-007 (NORM-001..003).

recommendations.title: Console log and plot titles misreport
recommendations.problem: Log prints nmode for the normalization; MA/volcano titles count FDR<=0.05 sites (1835) while the report uses |Fold|>=1 (1096).
recommendations.root_cause: deparse(substitute()) on a variable; DiffBind plots ignore the fold filter.
recommendations.fix: Log the resolved mode; pass th/fold to plots or note the difference. DAC-008.

recommendations.title: hg38 TxDb hard-coded
recommendations.problem: No genome argument or annotation bypass though method-reference advertises custom genomes.
recommendations.root_cause: Static library() of the hg38 TxDb.
recommendations.fix: Add a TxDb/genome parameter or state hg38-only. DAC-009.
